title: Area Map

| campaign = Eye of the North
}}
The [[Area Map]] is an interactive object found in the [[dungeon]]s of [[Eye of the North]]. Interacting with it will reveal the location of keys, doors, cracked walls and bosses on the current dungeon level.

==Locations==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** All floors of all [[dungeon]]s.

==Text==
''Pressing "U" will now reveal important locations for this level.''

==Notes==
* Rather than searching for the Area Map of the accordant dungeon level, one can also use a [[Dungeon Map]] obtained from a collector that will have the same effect on use.
